A_lead_day13_to14.observation: No common opponent-positive SELL-Cash pulse. Cash residual contracts in all five while productive-State residual was expanding.

A_response_day14_to15.observation: Opponent SELL Cash exceeds self in all five. Total unit count alone does not explain the Cash gap: self sells at least as many total units in four of five Battles, yet opponent realizes more SELL Cash in all five.

B_lead_day16_to17.observation: SELL-Cash residual is small/mixed and Cash residual is near-flat/mixed while productive-State residual expands.

B_response_day17_to18.observation: Opponent SELL Cash exceeds self in all five, and the SELL-Cash residual is numerically very close to the total Cash-state residual change in every Battle.

cross_map_observation: The fixed Market terrain is a state surface: price is determined by shared market inventory, not by time alone.
In both Production-led intervals, opponent SELL-Cash advantage is absent or small/mixed.
In both following response intervals, opponent SELL-Cash advantage becomes positive in all five Battles.
A-response shows that sale quantity alone is insufficient: self sells at least as many units in four of five Battles but realizes less Cash in all five.
B-response shows an even tighter accounting correspondence between SELL-Cash residual and Cash-state residual growth.

The observed Market shape therefore complements the Asset Map: assets near output boundaries are followed by a later interval in which different product composition reaches the market and realizes Cash.
boundary: This is an accounting/time-position observation, not proof that a particular produced unit is the same unit later sold.
No claim is made that MELON, WOOL, MILK, or any asset should be selected.
No profitability ranking is formed from realized prices.
Cash-state change includes BUY/HIRE/LAND and other market cash flows; it is not equated to SELL Cash.
The Asset Map, Market Map, and Battle Path remain separate surfaces.
Candidate selection still requires return to Battle and terminal self.
current_position: Asset Map and Market Map now jointly show the repeated public-world sequence without requiring an internal causal model: near-output productive State -> later realized output/sellable inventory -> exact SELL Cash -> Cash-state residual.
